ar: وَصَلِّ وَ سَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَاسْقِنَا مِنْ لَدُنْكَ صَافِيَ الشَّرَابِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘sqinā min ladunka ṣāfiya ‘sh-sharāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and slake us from Your Self with the purest drink!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَفَهِّمْنَا أَسْرَارَ الْكِتَابِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa fahhimnā asrāra ‘l-kitāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and let us understand the secrets of the book!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَاجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْأَنْجَابِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Wa ‘j`alnā bi ‘ṣ-Ṣalāti `alayhi min ‘l-anjāb.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and make us, by sending prayers upon him, of the elect!
